en.topic_title: Powerful quake off Indonesia kills 20, sparks mass evacuations
en.topic_summary:
By Arnold Welianto and Dessy Sagita in Jakarta



Rescuers combed through debris for survivors Saturday after a powerful earthquake struck off Flores island in eastern Indonesia, killing at least 20 people and sending thousands fleeing.



This handout picture taken and released on August 15, 2026 by Indonesia’s National Search and Rescue Agency (BASARNAS) shows rescuers working amid the rubble of a damaged building after an earthquake in Maumere, East Nusa Tenggara. Photo: Handout/AFP.
